summary.headline: Sirius and Canopus Omens
summary.text: Discussion of recording the rising and setting of famous fixed stars, especially Sirius and Canopus, in almanacs and agricultural practice. Their appearances guide talismanic actions, alchemy, farming, medical procedures, lunar omens, thunder observations, and judgments about the year's events.
